races.name: Darley EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Pursuit Of Love
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with class edge returning from 56-day break under champion jockey Buick for in-form Appleby stable

runners_data.name: Quiet Summer
runners_data.note: Unknown running style and completely unexposed with no recent form data creating major tactical uncertainty
runners_data.comment: 13,000euros yearling from a good German middle-distance family; tough task on debut
runners_data.spotlight: 13,000euros yearling; ninth foal; half-brother to seven winners including Quian (1m-2m Flat including 2yo/German Group 3, RPR 104; 2m-2m3f hurdle) and Laggata (9.4f; 76); dam German 1m4f winner, half-sister to triple 1m4f Group 1 winner Quijano; should have a bright future but he makes his debut in a good novice.

runners_data.name: Ravenspire
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner fresh from impressive Southwell win who should get uncontested lead in small field
runners_data.comment: Impressed at Southwell (1m4f) last month; up against a useful opponent but can do better
runners_data.spotlight: Created a positive impression when easily winning a 1m4f novice at Southwell last month, coming home 3l clear of a stablemate of Pursuit Of Love; likely he will need more to follow up but he is still of serious interest.

runners_data.name: Poker
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 180-days off wearing headgear for first time but facing significant class deficit
runners_data.comment: Upped in trip and fitted with headgear for his return; needs to leave 2yo form behind him
runners_data.spotlight: Ran to a modest level in novices on good to soft ground last autumn (7f and 1m1f); upped in trip and tried in headgear for his reappearance and this 4,300,000gns yearling remains capable of better.

races.paceDynamic: Ravenspire will dictate from the front without serious pressure, creating a sustainable tempo over this 1m4f trip. Pursuit Of Love and Poker are likely to track prominently behind the leader, while Quiet Summer's positioning remains unclear given limited data. The uncontested pace scenario strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can position close to the action. This race shape clearly benefits horses with early speed who can secure good positions without energy expenditure.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Ravenspire Wire To Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Ravenspire gets an easy lead and maintains rhythm
scenarios.body: The leader dictates comfortable fractions and proves too strong when challenged, having saved energy throughout. His recent Southwell win suggests he has the class edge when allowed to dominate.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pursuit Of Love Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Pursuit Of Love tracks the leader and times his challenge perfectly
scenarios.body: The Appleby runner uses superior class to reel in Ravenspire in the final furlong, benefiting from the sustainable pace. William Buick's tactical nous proves decisive in a small field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Quiet Summer Unknown Factor
scenarios.trigger: If the lightly-raced Balding runner shows significant improvement
scenarios.body: The unexposed three-year-old surprises with a bold showing, though lack of recent form data makes this a wildcard scenario. The breeding suggests stamina for this trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Poker Long Shot Success
scenarios.trigger: If the headgear and trip increase spark dramatic improvement
scenarios.body: The Burke second-string benefits from the uncontested pace to run his best race for months. However, his moderate form figures make this highly unlikely.

watchPoints.text: Quiet Summer's positioning early will reveal tactical intentions given complete lack of form evidence
Ravenspire must handle the step up from all-weather to turf after his Southwell success
Pursuit Of Love's fitness levels after 56-day absence may determine challenge timing
Poker's headgear debut could signal trainer confidence despite poor recent form
The small field creates limited pace pressure which may favour the natural leader Ravenspire

races.name: William Hill Price Boosts Every Day EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Brighton Beach
runners_data.comment: Half-sister to six winners and should have a future; trainer also runs Chimes Of Thunder
runners_data.spotlight: Eighth foal; half-sister to six winners including Alkandora (10.5f Listed; RPR 107), Persian Royal (1m; 97) and Cambric (1m4f-1m6f; 84); dam Listed-placed 1m 2yo winner (103); one of two for William Haggas but Tom Marquand rides Chimes Of Thunder.

runners_data.name: Mountain Of Light
runners_data.comment: 425,000gns half-sister to two winners out of a useful 6f winner; market check advised
runners_data.spotlight: 425,000gns yearling; third foal; half-sister to winners Manara (1m-1m4f; RPR 89) and Dance Desire (Saudi Arabia 7f-1m1f); dam 6f winner (96), out of close relative of 1m2f Group 1 winner Wavering and half-sister to 1m2f 2yo Group 1 winner Mandaean; market strength would look significant.

runners_data.name: Sedeirah
runners_data.comment: Dam a Group-placed 1m/1m2f winner (RPR 115); makes her debut with her trainer in fine form
runners_data.spotlight: Second foal of a Group-placed 1m/1m2f winner (RPR 115), herself from a good family; makes her debut for a stable in good form and she needs a look in the betting.

runners_data.name: Chimes Of Thunder
runners_data.comment: Promise on sole 2yo start for D Menuisier (7f, good); open to improvement over 1m+
runners_data.spotlight: Dropped away in the final furlong on her Salisbury debut last October (7f, good; trained by David Menuisier), a race that developed into a three-furlong sprint; should appreciate today's longer trip and she's an interesting contender starting out for William Haggas (same owners).

runners_data.name: Symbol Of Majesty
runners_data.comment: Did really well to win on debut (1m, AW) given she did a lot wrong; looks a good prospect
runners_data.spotlight: Smart pedigree; did really well to win a 1m fillies' novice at Chelmsford in December, blowing the start and having plenty to do turning for home but producing a fast finish to win under a hand ride; strong claims despite her penalty.

runners_data.name: Golden Mabel
runners_data.comment: 300-1 and finished well beaten on last month's Wolverhampton debut (8.6f)
runners_data.spotlight: 300-1 and finished well beaten on last month's Wolverhampton debut (8.6f).

runners_data.name: Silken Bay
runners_data.comment: Improved for a hood when springing 50-1 surprise at Southwell (1m) this month; more needed
runners_data.spotlight: Never in contention on her Wolverhampton debut in February (8.6f); fitted with a hood for her second start and she recorded a shock 50-1 success in a five-runner event over 1m at Southwell 23 days ago; this looks tougher under a penalty.

races.name: William Hill Epic Boosts Handicap

runners_data.name: The Angel King
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner making stable debut after 72 days off, stamina-laden profile may struggle in sprint finish
runners_data.comment: Two 7f wins on slower ground in France; sold 36,000euros since latest run; others safer
runners_data.spotlight: The winner of two of his six starts in France, both over 7f on ground slower than good; sold for 36,000euros in February; makes his stable debut in a competitive race.

runners_data.name: Cosi Bello
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 273-day layoff, strong 7f record but freshness concerns after long absence
runners_data.comment: Unexposed 4yo; stable in better form now and he is one to consider after nine months off
runners_data.spotlight: Began his career with two 7f AW wins and he was a fine second at Chester on his handicap debut last June (7f, good); fourth of 17 in a 1m handicap at Ascot when last seen nine months ago, a run that can be marked up as he raced away from the first three home; still has potential and he returns with his stable back in better form.

runners_data.name: Khafiz
runners_data.note: Prominent type with good 7f form, sold out of previous yard and returns after 183 days which raises questions
runners_data.comment: Conditions should suit and he has good record in a hood; new stable going well at present
runners_data.spotlight: Began 2025 with 7f novice wins at Kempton and Doncaster; ended his 3yo campaign with a close third at Doncaster (7f, soft) 183 days ago; sold out of Roger Varian's stable for 85,000gns in October; still has low mileage, is yet to run a poor race when wearing a hood and is starting out for a trainer in great form; lots to like.

runners_data.name: Henlein
runners_data.note: Only confirmed front runner with sustainable pace style, 420 days since last run is major concern despite class
runners_data.comment: Ex-Australian; Group 1 placed; absent 420 days; looks to face stiff task on British debut
runners_data.spotlight: Finished second in a Group 1 in Australia in October 2024 (1m2f, good; visored first time); well short of his best in two runs in early 2025 and has since been gelded and transferred to Britain; had a wind op prior to this first start for Kevin Ryan; no easy task under top weight.

runners_data.name: Great Acclaim
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in blinkers with strong 7f handicap form, recent run suggests return to form
runners_data.comment: Strong 7f handicap form in blinkers in 2025; headgear absent for return but back on today
runners_data.spotlight: Strong handicap form over 7f last summer, winning at Goodwood and Chepstow as well as finishing second in a 20-runner event at Ascot (all when wearing blinkers); still feasibly weighted on that form and he went without headgear when down the field in the Lincoln; the blinkers return today and he's a leading contender.

runners_data.name: Korker
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who fades in finish, stepping up to 7f should help but poor fresh record
runners_data.comment: Doncaster return easy to excuse; on dangerous mark and 7f looks an avenue worth exploring
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten at Doncaster on his return but he wasn't well drawn and has a modest record fresh; stepping up to 7f will give him more time to claw back the ground he's likely to forfeit at the start; on a dangerous mark and he's a lively outsider, for all his losing run stretches back to October 2023.

runners_data.name: Marshman
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who ran well over 7f last time, Listed form gives him strong claims at this level
runners_data.comment: Unexposed at 7f; better than he showed at Newcastle three weeks ago; not ruled out
runners_data.spotlight: Close third in Listed company at Wolverhampton last month on his first attempt at 7f and he wasn't beaten for a lack of stamina; not at his best in a hot sprint handicap at Newcastle on Good Friday; no surprise to see him bounce back with a big run.

runners_data.name: Sarab Star
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in peak form over 7f, Newcastle defeat can be excused and suits return to turf
runners_data.comment: Below par over 6f last time but on the up over 7f beforehand; now tries cheekpieces
runners_data.spotlight: His latest Newcastle defeat isn't the run to judge him on and he had been progressing well beforehand; no problem with the return to turf and stepping back up to 7f will be of benefit; interesting with cheekpieces now given a go.

runners_data.name: Cerulean Bay
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 178 days, strong 1m form suggests 7f may be minimum trip
runners_data.comment: Ended 2025 in fine form at 1m; may come on for this first start since October
runners_data.spotlight: Had strong handicap form over 1m in the second half of 2025, finishing second at York's Ebor meeting (good to firm) before recording back-to-back wins at Goodwood (good to soft and good); ran well for third in a Nottingham Listed race when last seen 178 days ago; only seventh in this race 12 months ago and he's 4lb higher today.

runners_data.name: Croupier
runners_data.note: Prominent type returning after 1038 days layoff, impossible to assess current ability after such absence
runners_data.comment: Smart handicapper for the Crisfords but he has a 1038-day absence to defy on stable debut
runners_data.spotlight: Progressive handicapper for the Crisfords and he was last seen finishing second in the Buckingham Palace at Royal Ascot (7f, good to firm) in June 2023; sold for 20,000gns in May 2024; only dropped 3lb during his 1038-day absence; likely best watched.

runners_data.name: Caburn
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner in peak form, impressive winning return suggests gelding operation has helped
runners_data.comment: Improved effort when 3rd in 6f Listed event four weeks ago; up 3lb and stamina not assured
runners_data.spotlight: Won a valuable pot as a 2yo; slow to come to hand as a 3yo but he changed yards last summer and made an impressive winning return from a gelding operation last September (6f, good to soft; cheekpieces on for the first time); fine reappearance when third in the Listed Cammidge Trophy at Doncaster (6f, good to soft) four weeks ago; raised 3lb for his troubles and still has to prove his stamina for 7f.

runners_data.name: Darkness
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with strong 7f record, Goodwood winner who handles the distance well
runners_data.comment: Stiff task on his return and finished well held; the absent visor remains a concern
runners_data.spotlight: Came good at Goodwood last August (7f, good to firm), running on strongly to bag a Class 2 handicap; faced a stiff task in a Thirsk conditions event on his reappearance two weeks ago; opposable with his usual visor remaining absent.

races.paceDynamic: Henlein stands alone as the confirmed front runner and will set a sustainable pace without pressure early. Cosi Bello, Khafiz, Great Acclaim, Sarab Star and Cerulean Bay will track in prominent positions, but none are natural gate-to-wire types. The middle portion will be steady with the prominent group content to wait, before a cavalry charge develops from the 2f pole as the hold-up horses Korker, Marshman, Caburn and Darkness get their chance. This controlled pace scenario strongly favours the prominent/midfield runners who can position handy and have something left for the finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Henlein sets a steady tempo and the prominent group tracks without pressure
scenarios.body: The pace will be genuine but not punishing, allowing those in touch to sprint home strongly. Prominent runners with tactical speed like Great Acclaim and Sarab Star can capitalise on perfect positioning.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Kick Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is too slow and becomes a sprint from the 2f pole
scenarios.body: Hold-up horses get the perfect scenario to unleash their finishing kicks from off the pace. Marshman's Listed form at 7f and Caburn's impressive return win become highly relevant.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Henlein gets easy fractions and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The lone leader gets first run and builds an unassailable advantage before the field can respond. His Group 1 placing in Australia demonstrates class that could prove decisive with the right setup.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses refuse to track Henlein and he gets very easy fractions
scenarios.body: The race becomes a 2f dash where pure speed matters most, disadvantaging stamina-laden types. Those with gate speed like Cosi Bello can capitalise despite prominence preferences.

watchPoints.text: Henlein faces serious fitness concerns after 420 days off despite being the lone pace angle
Cosi Bello and Cerulean Bay return from long layoffs that could blunt their effectiveness significantly
Great Acclaim's blinkers application suggests connections expect improved performance from recent disappointing runs
Korker's tendency to fade in finishes could be exposed if the pace becomes too strong early
Marshman and Caburn represent the main hold-up threats if the pace becomes tactical

races.name: William Hill Bet Builder Winnings Boost Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Cancelled
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits but 45 days off and dropping weights suggests connections lack confidence after poor Southwell effort
runners_data.comment: Not at her best last month; down in the weights and today's return to turf should suit
runners_data.spotlight: Shaped okay at Wolverhampton on her return from 11 months off in December but she failed to back it up at Southwell last month; dropping down the weights and this return to turf could be beneficial.

runners_data.name: Cavolo Nero
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner perfectly placed if pace collapses, Ferguson 0/2 recent but Muscutt knows the horse well from good Kempton second
runners_data.comment: Good 2nd on AW return last month; poorly positioned when 3rd over 1m2f latest; solid
runners_data.spotlight: Two wins over shorter as a 3yo; improved when second at Kempton on his seasonal return last month (1m) and when third at Nottingham 17 days ago he found himself poorly positioned; well worth another crack at this trip and he should make a bold bid.

runners_data.name: Ted Le Saux
runners_data.note: Lone leader with Buick booking, 40 days freshening ideal for Balding who times returns well

runners_data.name: Winter Flower
runners_data.note: Prominent runner but 143 days off is concern despite Haggas/Marquand combination clicking when ready
runners_data.comment: Lightly raced filly; conditions should be fine and drop back in class will help; chance
runners_data.spotlight: Only four ran when she won her novice at Newcastle (1m2f) last September; better form in handicaps on her last two starts, second at Newcastle (1m4f) and a close sixth in a Class 2 at Lingfield when last seen in December; still has time to better now returned to turf.

runners_data.name: Due To Henry
runners_data.note: Prominent style compromised by traffic, 187 days off and 9lb drop suggests best days behind him
runners_data.comment: Did well in 2024 but last season was difficult; returns with a point to prove
runners_data.spotlight: Three wins, two on soft ground, as a 3yo and he is now 9lb lower than for the latest; generally struggled last year though, before and after wind surgery, and he has too much to prove for comfort.

runners_data.name: Ouro Preto
runners_data.note: Non-runner removes one prominent rival but was facing wrong surface anyway after French mud form
runners_data.comment: Three-time winner in France; market useful back from a break on new ground
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time winner in France, the latest a claiming success over 1m4f at Longchamp last September (very soft ground); now tackles a much faster surface than he is accustomed to but his brother Ring Of Beara handled good, and probably good to firm too; betting to guide.

runners_data.name: Jujubella
runners_data.note: Prominent runner missing cheekpieces that accompanied all four 2025 wins, 190 days off adds to concerns
runners_data.comment: Four wins last year all came in cheekpieces which are absent for her seasonal return
runners_data.spotlight: Four wins in 2025, including at this track (extended 1m3f); all of those were in cheekpieces (absent today) and others may have her measure.

runners_data.name: Empire Of Light
runners_data.note: Course winner but 217 days off huge negative, prominent style will face traffic but Tuer 2/10 suggests confidence
runners_data.comment: Made all to win at Chester (10.3f, heavy) 218 days ago; this is tougher up 4lb after break
runners_data.spotlight: Back to winning ways with a front-running 10.3f success in the mud at Chester last September; this course winner will need to return at the top of his game if he is to defy this 4lb higher mark.

runners_data.name: Roarin' Success
runners_data.note: Prominent mare fresh from hurdles stint, 1m4f may have found her out at Thirsk so this trip more suitable
runners_data.comment: On a fair mark and dropping back in trip could help; others are more persuasive though
runners_data.spotlight: On a fair mark on her best Flat form for Harry Charlton; some promise over hurdles for new stable and 1m4f may have stretched her when back on the Flat at Thirsk two weeks ago.

runners_data.name: Naples
runners_data.note: Hold-up style needs pace collapse, claiming 3lb for Callan useful but 50-1 Doncaster effort was abysmal
runners_data.comment: 1m maiden win in Ireland came on soft ground; well beaten on stable debut; new trip today
runners_data.spotlight: His two peak efforts for Paddy Twomey came over 1m on soft ground; 50-1 when tailed off in the Spring Mile at Doncaster on his seasonal return; some encouragement for the longer trip on pedigree but he is not a solid option.

races.paceDynamic: Ted Le Saux will lead unchallenged early with Winter Flower, Due To Henry, Jujubella, and Empire Of Light all wanting prominent positions behind him. This creates a tactical logjam with four horses fighting for the same real estate, likely forcing some wider or further back than ideal. The sustained gallop over this extended distance will string out the field, with hold-up horses Cavolo Nero and Naples needing the pace to collapse. This race shape strongly favors the lone leader Ted Le Saux and any hold-up horse that gets the right gaps, as the prominent runners will compromise each other.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leader Gets Away
scenarios.trigger: If Ted Le Saux establishes a soft lead without pressure from the prominent pack.
scenarios.body: The unchallenged leader can dictate fractions and kick clear when the prominent runners start fighting each other turning for home. Ted Le Saux benefits from splendid isolation while Cavolo Nero could pick up the pieces if given a clear run.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Royal
scenarios.trigger: If Winter Flower, Due To Henry, Jujubella and Empire Of Light all race keenly for the same position.
scenarios.body: These four will go at unsustainable fractions trying to sit second, setting up the race for a closer with tactical speed. Naples and Cavolo Nero can benefit from the pace meltdown if they get racing room when it matters.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Winter Flower Breaks Free
scenarios.trigger: If Winter Flower can secure sole possession of second place behind Ted Le Saux.
scenarios.body: The Haggas mare gets the perfect trip tracking the leader while her rivals fight behind, then has the class to outkick Ted Le Saux when William Buick asks. Her September form at this trip gives her the edge in a tactical finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Empire Repeats Course Form
scenarios.trigger: If Empire Of Light can work into contention despite the traffic and repeat his Chester front-running win.
scenarios.body: The course winner finds gaps when others can't and his mud form translates to this good ground over a trip that suits. Grant Tuer's 2/10 record suggests when they're ready, they're ready.

watchPoints.text: Ted Le Saux and how much rope William Buick gives him early - if he gets loose it's over
Winter Flower's jumping from the stalls after 143 days off - needs to be handy early or traffic will kill her chances
Cavolo Nero getting clear racing room turning for home - Ferguson's hold-up horses need luck in running
The prominent quartet of Winter Flower, Due To Henry, Jujubella and Empire Of Light all fighting for the same piece of ground
Naples showing any early zip compared to his tailed-off Doncaster return - needs to prove that run was just rustiness

races.name: William Hill Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap

runners_data.name: See Blue
runners_data.note: Front-runner returning from 42-day break with winning AW form but faces stronger pace pressure here
runners_data.comment: Arrived late to justify support on AW debut; toppled by useful type since; turf debut
runners_data.spotlight: Hit the front in the nick of time when justifying support on his Kempton AW debut in September but he was easily outpointed by a promising type on Southwell reappearance (1m) last month, when much more use was made of him; interesting to see the tactics on turf debut but should do better.

runners_data.name: Spiritoftheblues
runners_data.note: Natural leader returning from long 194-day absence, won over 7f on good going but stamina questions remain
runners_data.comment: Winning 7f debut; looked sure to be suited by 1m on AW next time but she disappointed
runners_data.spotlight: Needed every yard of 7f on Ayr debut (good) in August but the further she went the better she looked; the step up to 1m should have suited on Kempton AW in October but she found disappointingly little; returns to action with something to prove.

runners_data.name: Go Rimbaud
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with golden breeding for this trip, consistent form and only 17 days since last run
runners_data.comment: Golden pedigree; hard to quantify recent 1m AW maiden win when making all; could progress
runners_data.spotlight: Golden pedigree, dam had four Group 1 winners (at 1m up to 2m4f) among her siblings, including Friendly Soul for this yard; this one hasn't been as dynamic as the latter so far and his defeat of some newcomers and handicap prospects on Kempton AW (1m; made all) 17 days ago was hard to assess in merit terms; needs more now handicapping but that's quite possible.

runners_data.name: Commanding Officer
runners_data.note: Proven on good going at Haydock, prominent style suits but faces toughest field yet after 233-day break
runners_data.comment: Off the mark on third start, a C&D novice in September; open to progress; handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Ran up against smart types on first two 7f starts, on this track and at York (both on good), keeping on pleasingly into third on debut, then ran to similar level next time; was in the right place at the right time, unlike the second, when winning a C&D novice in September; open to improvement as a 3yo; goes handicapping with cheekpieces fitted.

runners_data.name: Mr Seagull
runners_data.note: Early winner who struggled in softer ground, returning after 210-day layoff to this preferred good surface
runners_data.comment: 6f winner on debut; well held in two sales races in September; tough return upped to 1m
runners_data.spotlight: Bright start, winning at Pontefract (6f, good to firm) then had work cut out trying to give weight to a promising newcomer on AW; big prices and well beaten in two sales races when last seen in September; gelded since and now goes in cheekpieces on handicap debut; faces a tough return upped to 1m.

runners_data.name: Electrical
runners_data.note: Sharp 6f winner stepping back up in trip after disappointing in Listed company, 183 days off track
runners_data.comment: Bred to stay well but sharp enough to win over 6f on debut; excuses since; handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Bred to stay further than 1m but was sharp enough to win 6f Newbury novice (good to firm) on debut; found wanting in two later runs but in Listed company first and soft ground may not have suited back at Newbury (1m); gelded since; this first handicap looks competitive.

runners_data.name: Strength Of Spirit
runners_data.note: In-form hold-up specialist with 93 RPR, perfectly positioned to exploit the expected strong pace
runners_data.comment: 2-2 in handicaps, readily over 7f (good to firm) and 1m (good to soft); up 4lb; unexposed
runners_data.spotlight: Has taken great strides since winning a seller last June, winning with authority on handicap debut at Newbury (7f, good to firm) on final 2yo start and he again had reserves when successful at Musselburgh (1m, good to soft) this month; up 4lb but he's anything but exposed; respected.

runners_data.name: Gold Dawn
runners_data.note: Consistent maiden who ran well when prominent over this trip at Newmarket, headgear change noted
runners_data.comment: Ran well in all three handicaps as 2yo, at 7f and 1m; tough to get off the mark today
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden who ran well in all three handicaps at 7f and 1m, making most when runner-up over this trip at Newmarket (good) in September; this looks a tough race in which to get off the mark; yard also runs Mr Seagull.

runners_data.name: Dunkeld Dreamer
runners_data.note: Versatile winner over various distances, prominent style but faces 12lb rise after recent handicap success
runners_data.comment: Won 3 handicaps at about 1m as 2yo but still 12lb higher than for the latest of them
runners_data.spotlight: Ten 2yo runs, winning three handicaps at about 1m (good to firm, good and soft); took a hefty rise for the latest of them and is now 12lb higher; creditable comeback at Musselburgh recently but surprising if she's well enough treated to win today; yard also runs Strength Of Spirit.

races.paceDynamic: See Blue, Spiritoftheblues and Electrical will clash from the gates, creating a genuine gallop over this staying mile trip. With Go Rimbaud, Commanding Officer, Mr Seagull, Gold Dawn and Dunkeld Dreamer all wanting prominent positions, the first half-mile will see serious congestion and positioning battles. The strong early pace will stretch the field approaching the home turn, but crucially test stamina reserves in the final two furlongs. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses like Strength Of Spirit who can capitalize on the inevitable pace collapse.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners engage in a speed duel through halfway
scenarios.body: The strong gallop will compromise the leaders and prominent runners, allowing late runners to sweep past tired horses in the final furlong. Strength Of Spirit's hold-up style perfectly suits this most likely outcome.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent racers secures the perfect tactical position behind the pace
scenarios.body: Go Rimbaud or Commanding Officer could time their move perfectly, benefiting from the pace without being part of the early burn. Their class and tactical speed gives them the edge over pure hold-up types.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If See Blue or Spiritoftheblues gets an uncontested lead with the other pace-setters faltering early
scenarios.body: A lone leader could control fractions and kick clear, especially if the prominent pack gets caught in traffic. See Blue's recent winning form makes him the most likely beneficiary.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Decides
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion causes severe interference or checks in the straight
scenarios.body: Random positioning from traffic problems could throw form out the window, allowing any horse with a clear passage to capitalize. The Burke-trained runners know how to find gaps.

runners_data.name: Stoic Poet

runners_data.name: Whiskey Kisses

runners_data.name: Houndhill

runners_data.name: Paranjape

runners_data.name: Jenny Jerome

runners_data.name: Flash Rascal

runners_data.name: John Barleycorn
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 218-day break with blinkers newly applied

runners_data.spotlight: Second of seven on his nursery debut last July (7f, good to firm) but that was followed by two lacklustre efforts (gelded before latest); back down in trip for his reappearance and goes in blinkers for the first time.

runners_data.name: Ellie's de Vega

runners_data.name: Call Me By My Name

runners_data.name: Full Gas

runners_data.spotlight: More encouraging signs with his staying-on fourth of 13 at Newcastle (6f) 12 days ago; dropped 2lb for his troubles and now has headgear added for the first time; could have a bigger effort lurking.

races.paceDynamic: G'Emmethegreenlite, Houndhill, and Call Me By My Name will ensure a strong gallop from the start with three confirmed front-runners in a small field. The pace will be genuinely testing over 6f at Haydock, creating a stamina examination despite the sprint distance. This sustained gallop will stretch the field and expose any lack of fitness from the long-absent runners. The race shape strongly favours prominent racers and hold-up horses with a finishing kick, as the early leaders may burn out in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners maintain a fierce pace throughout
scenarios.body: The early leaders will weaken in the final furlong, allowing hold-up horses with proven finishing speed to sweep past. Fresh runners with tactical speed will benefit most from this collapse.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters breaks clear and sustains
scenarios.body: G'Emmethegreenlite or Call Me By My Name could exploit their reduced marks to lead throughout if opponents fail to go with them early. The winner will need both pace and stamina to resist late challengers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If a horse settles just behind the leaders and times their move perfectly
scenarios.body: Black Endeavour or Paranjape could use their proven course form and tactical speed to strike at the optimal moment. They'll benefit from the strong pace without being embroiled in the early battle.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners go too fast and all three crack before the furlong pole
scenarios.body: The race will become a sprint finish between the midfield and hold-up horses, favouring those with the best turn of foot. This scenario requires extreme early fractions to materialize.

First-time headgear changes on Whiskey Kisses (cheekpieces), John Barleycorn (blinkers), and Full Gas (cheekpieces) could spark improvement
Call Me By My Name and G'Emmethegreenlite both racing off significantly reduced marks after disappointing campaigns

runners_data.name: Margorie

races.paceDynamic: Punchbowl Flyer will lead from the gates with no other confirmed front-runners in this field, likely getting an uncontested lead through steady fractions. Cherry Cobbler and Harry Mole may track close behind as prominent racers, but neither will pressure the leader early. The lack of early pace means Punchbowl Flyer can dictate terms before the hold-up brigade including Dandy Dinmont, Good Earth, and Andalprofit launch their challenges. This sustainable pace scenario clearly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can capitalise on the soft lead, while hold-up horses face the risk of the leader getting first run.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner Win
scenarios.trigger: If Punchbowl Flyer gets the expected soft lead and maintains his recent good form.
scenarios.body: The leader dictates comfortable fractions and kicks clear turning for home, holding off late challengers who leave their runs too late. Front-runners and prominent racers benefit from the lack of early pace pressure.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and allows closers to unleash devastating finishing kicks.
scenarios.body: The modest early gallop sets up a sprint finish where horses with tactical speed can make ground quickly in the final furlong. Quality hold-up horses with good recent form can overcome the pace bias.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Victory
scenarios.trigger: If Cherry Cobbler or Harry Mole track the leader closely and outstay Punchbowl Flyer in the final 100 yards.
scenarios.body: The prominent racers get ideal positioning behind the uncontested leader and have enough left to pass the pace-setter when he weakens. This rewards horses that can combine early positioning with finishing kick.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Improving Handicapper Shock
scenarios.trigger: If Sedgemoor or Judicature benefit from their recent wins and lower weights to spring a surprise.
scenarios.body: The light weights and confidence from recent victories allow these improvers to overcome less favourable draws or running styles. Class and form can triumph over pure pace positioning.
